principles.name: Complexity budgets are first-class
principles.description: Critical user and runtime paths should explicitly state acceptable time and space complexity.
visualHints: flag O(n) scans on hot paths

principles.name: Contracts precede implementation
principles.description: Interfaces, schemas, and acceptance criteria should stabilize before code fan-out.

principles.name: Observed evidence must stay distinct from declared intent
principles.description: Telemetry, incidents, and runtime traces should never overwrite declared system design without review.
antiPatterns: self-mutating architecture claims from logs alone
